# Source catalog and query recipes

Use this as a launchpad. Check whether each source is available, current, methodologically appropriate and licensed for the intended use. No single list covers every country or business model.

## Official cross-country data

- World Bank Data: https://data.worldbank.org/
- World Bank API: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/
- IMF Data: https://www.imf.org/en/Data
- OECD Data Explorer: https://data-explorer.oecd.org/
- UN Comtrade: https://comtradeplus.un.org/
- UN Comtrade API docs: https://comtradeapi.un.org/
- ILOSTAT: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/
- WTO Stats: https://stats.wto.org/
- UN Data: https://data.un.org/
- WHO data: https://www.who.int/data
- ITU DataHub: https://datahub.itu.int/
- UNIDO Statistics: https://stat.unido.org/
- Eurostat: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/data/database
- Google Trends: https://trends.google.com/trends/
- Google Public Data Explorer: https://www.google.com/publicdata/directory

## Official country-data starting points

Always discover the relevant country's own statistical office, central bank, industry ministry, regulator, tax/customs agency and public procurement portal.

Examples:
- India MOSPI: https://www.mospi.gov.in/
- India RBI: https://www.rbi.org.in/
- India data.gov.in: https://www.data.gov.in/
- India DGCI&S: https://www.dgciskol.gov.in/
- India GeM public procurement: https://gem.gov.in/
- US Census: https://www.census.gov/data.html
- US BLS: https://www.bls.gov/data/
- US Federal procurement: https://sam.gov/
- UK ONS: https://www.ons.gov.uk/
- UK Companies House: https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/
- UK Contracts Finder: https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/
- Canada Statistics Canada: https://www.statcan.gc.ca/
- Australia ABS: https://www.abs.gov.au/
- Singapore SingStat: https://www.singstat.gov.sg/
- UAE Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre: https://fcsc.gov.ae/
- UAE Central Bank: https://www.centralbank.ae/

## Customer pain and product evidence

- Reddit communities (where public and accessible): https://www.reddit.com/
- Hacker News / Show HN: https://news.ycombinator.com/
- GitHub issues and discussions: https://github.com/
- Product/company reviews and public app-store listings, accessed under their terms.
- Public procurement notices, vendor lists and award records.
- Public industry forums, professional groups and documented customer stories.

These are not necessarily representative. Record the sampling mechanism and look for opposing views.

## Optional APIs and indicator sources

These routes add value only for the matching question. No client library or credentials are required by the core package; use direct public HTTP endpoints where permitted, and record each call. Check current terms, coverage, retention and plan limits before use.

- **Hacker News Firebase API:** https://github.com/HackerNews/API — public discussion and product-launch signals. Qualitative, self-selected evidence only; not a prevalence or willingness-to-pay measure.
- **PyPI download statistics:** https://pypistats.org/api/ — time series for Python package adoption. Downloads are not unique users, active deployments or customers; third-party mirrors and retention windows limit interpretation. Cross-check with package maintenance and dependent-project evidence.
- **World Bank API:** https://api.worldbank.org/v2/ — official macroeconomic and demographic context. Indicator vintage and country coverage differ; macro data does not prove customer pain or demand.
- **Eurostat database/API:** https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/data/database — official European country/industry indicators. Compare like-for-like definitions, reference periods and revisions.
- **UN Comtrade API:** https://comtradeapi.un.org/ — merchandise trade for physical-product, manufacturing and distribution questions. Product codes, reporter/partner coverage, revisions and value/quantity units need checking.
- **OpenAlex API:** https://help.openalex.org/api/ — works, authors, institutions and research topics. Publication volume signals research activity, not market demand, readiness or buyer budgets.
- **Adzuna Intelligence API:** https://developer.intelligence.adzuna.com/ — labour-market/job-posting signals when account access, credentials and target-country coverage are suitable. Job listings are incomplete and do not equal all vacancies or actual hires; paid/account terms are optional and must be checked before use.

## Competition and company economics

- Official product pages, plans/pricing pages, docs, terms, changelogs, uptime/status pages and customer case studies.
- Company annual reports and filings (use the relevant country's official filing system).
- Procurement tenders and awarded contracts, not only vendor marketing.
- Marketplace listings and supplier catalogs, with list price separated from realised transaction price.

## Search-query recipes

Use these patterns and adapt to the country/sector:

1. `[problem] alternatives [country]`
2. `[competitor] pricing limits reviews [country]`
3. `[task] spreadsheet manual workaround forum`
4. `[problem] procurement tender contract [country]`
5. `[industry] compliance requirement effective date [country] official`
6. `[product/category] import export HS code [country] official`
7. `[job/task] hiring shortage cost survey [country]`
8. `[product] negative reviews missing feature cancellation`
9. `[sector] customer complaints ombudsman regulator [country]`
10. `[local-language problem phrase] alternative / expensive / delay / repair`

For every major idea, use multiple distinct query formulations and open primary sources where feasible. A source catalog is not a substitute for a source that actually supports the claim.
